The inclusion of a configId in the path indicates this is for Insight/Vault mappings only, as PA/SPAR mappings do not support the concept of configuration id.

info.name: Factset Gets an object given an ID. In this case ID retrieved from mapping Location header, object data in response body.

params.name: groupId
params.description: The ID of the group

params.name: objectId
params.description: The ID of the object

items.docs:
Raw object data can be found in the response body. This can be either the mapped PDF/PPT or STACH json, depending on the mapping. https://pages.github.factset.com/analytics-reporting/stachschema/#/ 

Optional request header "accept-encoding", with allowed values of "br" and "gzip". If accept-encoding is passed, the response is compressed.

info.name: Factset Gets a list of Documents that a user has access to.

items.docs:
Retrieves metadata around documents stored in the Analytics Datastore Service. Each Document will have a 'url' property which will act as a re-direct to the underlying document data

This end point supports pagination and filtering through the use of the request body listed below.

To discover what tags are available to filter on, see GET /tags and GET /tags/{name}/values to retrieve these filter values.

If the optimization has finished computing, the body of the response will contain result in JSON.
Otherwise, the optimization is still running and the X-FactSet-Api-PickUp-Progress header will contain a progress percentage.
